includeSpotlight.title: Spotlight videos as rows
includeSpotlight.description: Adds one row per recent Spotlight video (up to 25 per profile): views, shares, comments, boosts, caption, hashtags, duration, video and transcript links. $0.0005 per video.

includeMedia.title: Story and highlight media links
includeMedia.description: Keeps the current story snaps and saved highlights on each profile row, with media links and timestamps. No extra charge.
